messages:
Priya: FYI we closed the NovaHealth POC yesterday. They're ready to kick off the pilot but procurement needs a signed order form + PO (net60) before we spin up dedicated config. Also sent over a security questionnaire with a few open items. Can legal/finance weigh in?
Jordan: Can you attach the latest order form here? I'll scan for any non-standard billing or SLA language before we route.
Priya: Link: https://files.redwood.example/novah-orderform-v3.pdf. Total ARR equivalent $48k, applying $8k POC credit, pilot billed monthly pro rata.
Avery: On signatures: customer expects DocuSign envelope containing order form + PO. They want countersign from their finance lead and our CFO (Elena). Please confirm exact filenames so accounting matches.
Maya: Security flagged three main items: tenant-specific audit retention, ability to stream logs to their SIEM, and guarantees around metadata isolation in shared serving pools. I put draft responses in the SQ but legal needs to approve any DPA references.
Liam: SE notes: SAML SSO ✅, customer-managed KMS for model artifacts ✅, but shared inference cache isolation requires prefix namespaces. We can document controls for the pilot.
Jordan: Procurement added proposed clause removing the liability cap for "data leakage due to shared caching." We should not accept an unlimited carveout. Suggest alternate phrasing: commit to "documented isolation measures and remediation" and a targeted security review for pilot.
Priya: Quote from their email: "Client requests that data leakage via shared inference cache be excluded from limitation of liability"
Liam: Technical mitigation we can offer: per-tenant KV namespaces, prefix isolation, and a dedicated eviction policy for pilot tenants. Will add a sample config.
Avery: DocuSign flow note: envelope must include PO named PO_NovaHealth_395123.pdf and order form as nova-orderform-v3.pdf. docu-bot can generate when we confirm final versions. Billing contact should be billing@novah.org per the order form.
docu-bot: Prepared envelope ENV-2024-778 for nova-orderform-v3.pdf + PO_NovaHealth_395123.pdf. Pending signers: priya@redwood, elena@redwood, finance@novah.org.
Jordan: I'll draft redlines for the order form and the DPA by 5pm PT today. Plan: accept assurance language but push back on liability carveouts.
Maya: I'll finalize the SQ answers and mark remaining items that need engineering sign-off by 15:30.
Liam: Sample isolation snippet for legal/ops to reference:
```
# POC isolation example
enable_prefix_isolation: true
kv_namespace: novah-pilot-<tenant-id>
audit_forwarding: splunk://novah-collector.example.com:8088
```
Priya: Good. @Avery once legal confirms redlines, route envelope and attach the PO. If Finance requires we can set a payment hold but prefer not to delay pilot start 2024-05-06.
Elena: I'll countersign once the envelope is up. If they insist on SLA changes for a hosted pilot, route to me and sales leadership; we only accept SLA changes for Dedicated with engineering approval.
Avery: Will do. Also, procurement asked about KMS key rotation policy and whether Redwood can accept their external key manager for the pilot. If we enable CMK, we need the KMS appendix filled out.
Priya: I'll ask Nova to complete the KMS appendix and confirm rotation/IAM principals.
Jordan: Final callout: ensure the PO metadata (customer tax ID and remit address) matches the order form to avoid payment delays.
Priya: I'll confirm with the customer and update the envelope filenames accordingly. Thanks everyone. Closing when DocuSign is out. :white_check_mark:
